The synthetic data software platform **MostlyAI** at **mostly.ai** is provided and operated by **Syntho B.V.** (Syntho) (having originally been created and operated by **Mostly AI Solutions MP GmbH**).

### Supporting Evidence and Statements

* **Product/Domain:** **MostlyAI** at **mostly.ai**.
* **Current Operating Company:** **Syntho B.V.**
  * The site header and banner across **mostly.ai** state: 
    > *"Syntho acquired MOSTLY AI trademark and related assets. For full information see: Press release · Mostly AI powered by Syntho."*
  * Official acquisition announcement: 
    > *"Amsterdam, June 9, 2026 – Syntho, a leading provider of synthetic data solutions, today announced the acquisition of the MOSTLY AI Brand. Going forward, the MOSTLY AI brand will continue under the name 'MOSTLY AI, powered by Syntho.'"*
* **Original Developer/Entity:** Originally founded and operated by **Mostly AI Solutions MP GmbH** (Vienna, Austria) and **MOSTLY AI Inc.** prior to liquidation and the asset transfer to Syntho.
